notes_list.title: Electronic Transitions & Beer-Lambert Law
notes_list.basic_overview: UV spectroscopy deals with electronic transitions ($\sigma ightarrow \sigma^*, \pi ightarrow \pi^*, n ightarrow \pi^*$). Beer-Lambert Law states $A = \epsilon c l$.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
🧮 Extra Data Parameters:
- $\epsilon$ is the molar absorptivity coefficient.
- Auxochromes shift absorption towards longer wavelengths (Bathochromic / Red shift).
- Absorption maximum is designated as $\lambda_{max}$.

notes_list.title: UV Instrument Troubleshooting & Verification
notes_list.basic_overview: Focuses on instrument calibration, stray light limits, and pharmacopoeia compliance guidelines.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
🛠️ QC Troubleshooting Steps:
1. Baseline Drift: Check lamp intensity (Deuterium lamp for UV, Tungsten for Visible).
2. Wavelength Accuracy Check: Done using Holmium Oxide filter/solution.
3. Stray Light Error: Sample response looks non-linear at high concentrations.
